title: Yolk British Broad Beans Stir-fry
description: An earthy and chewy dish featuring broad beans with a dash-friendly twist, perfect for lazy Sunday meals.
instructions: Rinse and pick out the tough outer pods of the broad beans. Set aside.
Finely chop the garlic cloves. If using chili peppers, finely slice them as well.
Heat a wok or large frying pan with vegetable oil over medium-high heat. Add chopped garlic and chili peppers (if used) to sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add rinsed broad beans to the wok and stir fry for about 3-5 minutes, making sure they are evenly coated in the garlic and oil mixture.
Toss in red pepper flakes to taste. If using dash-friendly sauce like Dashi or Soy Sauce, add this at the end of the cooking process to avoid overcooking the beans.
Serve hot with a side dish of your choice.
